newsitem.title: UK: British Airways up on talk of "open skies".
newsitem.headline: British Airways up on talk of "open skies".

text.p: Shares in British Airways rose on Tuesday amid talk of a possible open-skies deal with the U.S. that would help clear the way for a planned tie-up with American Airlines.
BA shares were up 8p at 592-1/2 by 1100 GMT.

"There is talk that they are getting close to an open-skies deal that would help the American Airlines deal to go through," said one dealer. "If an agreement can be found, BA shares will have another strong run."
Britain, which is one of the few major European nations not to have an open-skies agreement with the U.S., is to resume trans-Atlantic air services talks with Washington this week.
Progress in the talks is crucial to whether the U.S. authorities approve BA's approved alliance with American. -- Brian Killen, London newsroom 44 171 542 7972
